r04_alternative_route.draft:
From Powerscroft Road (E5) to Liverpool Street, the fastest option TfL returned is about 37 minutes with one change:

- Bus 158 to Stratford Bus Station (about 5 minutes)
- Then bus N8 to Liverpool Street Station (about 26 minutes)
- Fare: £1.75 adult pay-as-you-go single

A slightly slower alternative is about 40 minutes: bus 69 to Drapers Field, then bus N205 to Liverpool Street, also £1.75.

Two caveats worth knowing:
- The journey planner anchored the start at Leyton station (E5 postcode district) rather than the exact house number, so add a few minutes for the walk from the door to the stop.
- The routes returned are bus-only, and the N8/N205 are night-bus numbers, so this looks like an off-peak or night-time plan. At normal daytime hours the Central line from Leyton to Liverpool Street is usually quicker — I can re-run it for a specific date and time if you tell me when you would travel.

Source: TfL Unified API Journey Planner (live).
